project_overview.title: Sofi Rzaeva — Female Fitness Mentor Landing Page

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a responsive single page React landing page for Sofi Rzaeva in Russian.
Use Tailwind CSS and framer-motion for smooth entrance animations and scroll triggers.
Ensure all buttons and interactive items have unique data-testid attributes.
Do NOT fabricate credentials, medical guarantees, fake reviews, or invented client results.
Keep service price tags clearly marked as editable placeholders (e.g. 'от 15 000 ₽ / мес').
All main CTAs must direct visitors to Telegram (https://t.me/sofi_rzaevaa).
Include direct clickable links for Instagram (https://www.instagram.com/sofi.rzaeva?rpxt=ZDRheGV1OG9xaXEz) and Telegram.
The contact inquiry form should format the user input into a prefilled message and open Telegram on submission.
Integrate Lenis for smooth scrolling performance.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid AI slop: create distinctive, premium, memorable frontends.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Never center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
